content.Title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.Summary: The guideline covers the treatment and management of heart failure, with a focus on different drug treatments, the role of genetic testing, and management of specific conditions like cardiac amyloidosis.

genes.context: Diagnostic performance of quantifiable kappa and lambda free light chain assays in clinical practice... Cost-effectiveness of tafamidis therapy for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy... Unveiling transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis.
